record.oneLiner: A large horned, frilled herbivorous ceratopsian.
record.description: Triceratops was a large four-legged herbivore bearing a bony frill and three facial horns, showing convergent evolution with rhinoceroses. It lived on Laramidia (western North America) at the very end of the Cretaceous and shared its landscape with — and was most likely preyed on by — Tyrannosaurus. The best-known ceratopsian, it is documented from many specimens spanning hatchling to adult.

notableFacts.text: Bore three facial horns and a large bony frill, likely used in display and species recognition.
Some research argues Torosaurus is just the mature form of Triceratops — still disputed.
Shared its world with Tyrannosaurus and was most likely preyed upon by it.
